answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks by mandating that each identity submit unique original analyses of challenges, scored by a rotating jury of peers on coherence and novelty. This works because fakes cannot share answers without detection as duplicates. It costs an attacker the full inference budget to craft a high-scoring response for every identity, like cracking open a walnut to reach its kernel or polishing each opal individually, rather than mass-producing cheap clones.
